title: Planescape: Torment
shortDescription: The immortal Nameless One awakes in the Mortuary of Sigil seeking the nature of what can change the nature of a man.
historicalSignificance: Universally revered as one of the greatest literary achievements in video game history, prioritizing dialogue and philosophy over combat.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
